literal_meaning: মাটি, বাঁশ ইত্যাদি দিয়ে তৈরি অস্থায়ী বা সাধারণ ঘর
figurative_meaning_en: A house made of mud, bamboo, and similar raw materials
example_sentences_in_bangla: গ্রামে তার কাঁচাঘরে সকলে সুখে থাকে।
নিজহাতে গড়া কাঁচাঘর তার কাছে সবচেয়ে প্রিয়।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone lives happily in his kancha ghor in the village.
The kancha ghor built by his own hands is his favorite.
history: Refers to traditional temporary or semi-permanent dwellings in Bengali villages, often built during seasonal migrations or floods.
note: This term evokes simplicity and self-reliance in Bengali rural culture, as seen in folk songs and literature.
